build_bigbird_encoder: build a BigBird encoder model with block-sparse attention for processing long sequences up to 4096 tokens
create_bigbird_masked_lm: create a BigBird masked language model for bidirectional self-attention pretraining on masked tokens
run_bigbird_question_answering: run a BigBird question answering model that extracts answer spans from long documents
test_bigbird_sequence_classification: test a BigBird sequence classification model for GLUE tasks on long text inputs
review_bigbird_block_sparse_attention: review the BigBird block-sparse attention mechanism that combines global, sliding, and random token attention
